intro: We have undertaken a review of comparable vehicles currently advertised in the retail market in order to establish the pre-accident retail value of the subject vehicle.
marketResearch: The following comparable retail market evidence has been reviewed having regard to make, model, age, mileage, engine, transmission, specification and general condition.

valuationCommentary: The subject vehicle is a well-specified 320d M Sport finished in a desirable metallic colour, presenting with mileage commensurate with its age.

Having regard to the comparable evidence set out above, the retail market for this derivative sits within a range of approximately £22,995 to £26,750, with the cluster of closely comparable examples falling between £23,990 and £25,495.
We have placed greatest weight on the examples closest in age, mileage and specification to the subject vehicle and have made appropriate allowance for the differences noted.
conclusion: It is our professional opinion that the pre-accident retail value of the subject vehicle is £24,750.00. We confirm that we have no financial interest in the settlement of this claim and see no reason to deviate from our independent assessment.
